leadText:
(Japanese: ポケットモンスター～よりみちぼるてっか～ず！！～ Pocket Monsters ~The Detouring !!~) is a series by りっか Ricca Kise. It is based on Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It was serialized in the Ciao magazine from the September 2023 issue (released on August 3, 2023) to the August 2024 issue (released on July 3, 2024). It is 112 pages long.

This is the only Pokémon Horizons: The Series manga to present an original story. In each chapter, Liko interacts with a Pokémon from the Rising Volt Tacklers and its Trainer.
